Mark Ruffalo Faces Backlash Over Comments Linking Paramount Merger to Gaza

Actor Mark Ruffalo has become embroiled in a controversy following his comments on the proposed merger between Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery. Ruffalo initially criticized the merger, linking the Ellison family, owners of Oracle and significant stakeholders in the media landscape, to the conflict in Gaza. This statement led to accusations of antisemitism, which Ruffalo later addressed, clarifying that his criticism was not directed at Jewish people but at the actions of specific entities and individuals. The controversy highlights a clash between criticism of corporate actions and accusations of antisemitic sentiment.
